model.summary: Model favors CIN by 1.9 points (58% win chance). Biggest factors: Elo rating (CIN +2.1), Quarterback rating (CIN +1.6), Offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (ATL +1.3). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 48.3 total points (ATL 23, CIN 25). Biggest factors: Expected points from both teams' scoring (season blend) (raises total 0.9), Combined quarterback ratings (raises total 0.8), Neutral-site game (lowers total 0.8). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
